caseName: Reynolds v. Board of Public Instruction
caseNameFull: Reynolds v. Board of Public Instruction
attorneys: Mr. Alonzo Wilder for petitioner., Messrs. J. V. Keen and Robert W. Shackleford for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas and Mr. Justice Murphy are of opinion that the petition should be granted.
